title: Workflow Zustand slice
description: Create workflowSlice.ts following the AppSlice<T> pattern established by intelligenceSlice.ts. Manages workflow list, current execution state, and step results on the client side.
action: Create src/stores/app/workflowSlice.ts with WorkflowSliceState interface and createWorkflowSlice() function. Manages workflows[], activeExecution, loading states. Register in appStore.ts root store.

criteria: src/stores/app/workflowSlice.ts exists and exports createWorkflowSlice and WorkflowSliceState
WorkflowSliceState has workflows: Workflow[], activeExecution: WorkflowExecution | null, isLoading: boolean, error: string | null
Slice has fetchWorkflows() action that calls workflowService.loadWorkflows()
appStore.ts integrates workflow slice via createWorkflowSlice()
convergence.verification: npx tsc --noEmit exits 0; slice actions callable from store
convergence.definition_of_done: Workflow slice manages all workflow and execution state, registered in root store

files.change: New Zustand slice with workflow state management and async actions
Import and integrate createWorkflowSlice into root store

implementation: Define WorkflowSliceState: { workflows: Workflow[]; activeExecution: WorkflowExecution | null; isLoading: boolean; error: string | null }
Follow intelligenceSlice.ts pattern: define createWorkflowSlice(set, get) returning AppSlice<WorkflowSliceState>
Implement fetchWorkflows: set isLoading true → workflowService.loadWorkflows() → set workflows + isLoading false
Implement saveWorkflow: workflowService.saveWorkflow(w) → fetchWorkflows() to refresh list
Implement startExecution: workflowService.executeWorkflow(wid, cid) → set activeExecution
Implement rejectStep: workflowService.rejectStep(activeExecution) → set activeExecution to null
Export WorkflowSliceState type and createWorkflowSlice function
In appStore.ts: import createWorkflowSlice, add to store composition

success_metrics: Actions properly typed with async returns

reference.pattern: Follow intelligenceSlice.ts exactly: AppSlice<WorkflowSliceState> with set/get pattern, same loading/error state shape

rationale.chosen_approach: Single flat slice follows intelligenceSlice pattern — simpler than nested sub-slices, proven in Phase 1
decision_factors: Single slice sufficient for workflow + execution state
